questions.explanation: OSHC is Overseas Student Health Cover — health insurance for international students in Australia.

options: International students on a student visa
questions.explanation: Students on an Australian student visa are generally required to hold OSHC for the length of their visa.

questions.text: In a medical emergency in Australia, which number should you call?
questions.explanation: 000 (triple zero) is Australia's emergency number for ambulance, fire and police.

questions.text: Where can you see your cover details and make a claim?
options: In the member app or online member services
You can't see them until your visa ends
questions.explanation: Your cover, digital membership card and claims are available in the member app and online.

questions.text: What should you do if your visa is extended?
options: Extend your OSHC so it matches your new visa dates
questions.explanation: You need to keep your OSHC active for the full duration of your visa, so extend it when your visa changes.
